dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: Haha, well then, how does jumping higher than a Qucusaurus sound? Wait, Qucusaurs don't jump either, do they? How about a squirrel... Higher than a squirrel!

dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: Either way, it's the real deal, the real deal I say! Just try it yourself — there's nothing more convincing than lived experience!
